description: The indicators GMM charts in its articles and dashboards (tourism, fiscal, trade, state-owned enterprises), each with its unit, source note and the latest 24 observations. Pages are at /dashboard. Paginates: when more results remain, the structured answer has a nextCursor (absent on the last page). To continue, call this tool again with the same arguments and cursor set to that value.

cursor.description: Continue a previous result: the nextCursor it returned, unchanged. Only valid with the same other arguments (limit may differ).

dashboard.description: Dashboard group: tourism-economy, sovereign-fiscal, trade-external, soe or other.

name: list_indicators

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page: pass it back as the cursor argument, with the same other arguments. Absent on the last page.

title: List chart indicators
